<!-- pr-reviewer: 8c9705ee5fc3e5ac0dae34c0e0c3732cba84fcc4 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Quick pass held (merges cleanly with main, body complete, quick gate and pinning tests named), so the PR was flagged ready and reviewed in full at the safety-floor depth.

**What looks good**
- Off means off: `options_value` writes `Explain` only when on, the project file key is `skip_serializing_if` off, and the helper returns `""` until the engine arms it. No golden or snapshot changed.
- Guards live in one PRELUDE helper (`explain.rs` `_explainComment`): printable ASCII only, `( ) ; %` removed, whitespace collapsed (no line break), a "- " lead for LinuxCNC active keywords, cut to `commentMax` (8..=255, anything else refused by name). Unknown G/M words are skipped, not guessed.
- Explain on with no/unknown `explains` is refused by the post's name before any hook runs (`engine.rs` ~117); `commentMax` out of range likewise.
- Undo: the switch rides the existing `SetPostOptions` / `SetSetupPostOptions`; `the_explain_switch_undoes_redoes_and_round_trips_the_project_file` pins it. Project key is additive (older files load; no version bump needed, same as `smoothing`).
- No new camcraft-* dependency edge, no Cargo.toml change; provenance on the new module; `explain.rs` 228 lines; unwrap/expect/panic only inside tests; decision file present.

**Local results (trial-merged with main, PR head 8c9705ee5)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` (all suites, incl. `explain` 4/4, lib explain unit tests 2/2) | all ok |
| app: explain_option 4, project_roundtrip 73, program_units 7, post_unit_word 5, setup_post_options 10, posting 17, commands_undo 30, tormach_post 10, carvera_post 4 (CWD `crates/app`) | all ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| UI suites | not run (no UI file touched) |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The helper only guards comment text. Whether a comment may sit inside a given block of a dialect (e.g. after a cycle call) is up to each post's `block()`; the opt-in posts (#1387-#1389) should pin that per dialect.
- A `semi` comment must be the last thing written on the line; the helper cannot enforce the post's write order.
- No shipped post declares `explains` yet, so Explain on is refused for every built-in by name (stated in the PR; `every_builtin_explains_or_is_refused_by_name` covers it).
- MCP tool and dialog switch are deferred to #1390, named in the PR body. No UI page is changed, so no screenshots are owed.
- Process: `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` is not a listed process file; no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump needed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 8c9705ee5fc3e5ac0dae34c0e0c3732cba84fcc4 -->
Update to the review above: main moved to 3de5be389 and PR #1394 no longer merges cleanly. `git merge-tree` reports one conflict, in `crates/post/src/post/js.rs` (the `Script::load` PRELUDE line that now also loads `EXPLAIN_JS`, and/or the new `arm_explain`). The code review above stands for the PR's own changes (post suites, app suites and clippy were green against the earlier main); no findings. Label set to `conflicts` and the PR is back to draft. Not fit to merge until main is re-merged into the branch at merge time (a hand-resolved conflict gets a delta review of the remerge-diff, and the post suites re-run).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merged main (96d0f366) into the branch to resolve a conflict in crates/post/src/post/js.rs (keep both sides): Script::load now concatenates PRELUDE, the rotary cap bindings from main (#1395/#1396) and this PR's explain() helper. No other file conflicted; diff against main lists only this PR's 16 files.

Targeted gate (all green): cargo test -p camcraft-post; camcraft-app tests explain_option, rotary_feed_cap, doosan_dnm_a_state, program_units; cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings. No golden or snapshot touched.

Head 61f2d68fae8076a6d06f48a076930ed184d9d654. Still a draft; ready for a delta review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 61f2d68fae8076a6d06f48a076930ed184d9d654 -->
Delta review: this stands on the full review at 8c9705ee (clean). The only new commit is a merge of main with one hand resolution.

Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

- `git show --remerge-diff 61f2d68f` shows only `crates/post/src/post/js.rs` (`Script::load`). The source is now PRELUDE, then main's `rotary_cap::ROTARY_CAP`, then the PR's `explain::EXPLAIN_JS`, then the script. Both sides are kept and the order is as specified.
- `git diff origin/main --stat` lists only the PR's 16 files. Nothing from main is dropped, and no refusal or rotary feed cap code changed.
- Option off, output is unchanged: the explain tests pass, and the rotary and units suites still pass unchanged.

Local results (merged tree, own worktree):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: all suites pass, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app` tests: explain_option 4, rotary_feed_cap 11, doosan_dnm_a_state 2, program_units 7, all pass.
- No goldens or snapshots touched.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge-time refresh class: DELTA (one hand resolution in `crates/post/src/post/js.rs`, both sides kept). Stands on the full review at 8c9705ee and the delta review at 61f2d68f. Flagged ready for the merge; nothing is pushed after this.
